annotations.title: NACE Code Lookup and Crosswalk: Rev. 2 to 2.1, ISIC

description: Look up an industry code in NACE Rev. 2.1, NACE Rev. 2 or UK SIC 2007: label in any of 24 EU languages, section, division and group, what the class includes and excludes, the matching codes in the other revision (with a flag when one old class is split across new ones) and ISIC Rev. 4. Search by code or by words. Official EU Vocabularies data, CC BY 4.0. Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).

code.description: A NACE code such as 62.10, 6210, 62.1, 62 or J, or a five-digit UK SIC 2007 code such as 62012.

codes.description: Up to 100 codes in one run (Apify Actor only). Each code that is found is one billable result.

includeNotes.description: Add the explanatory notes (what the class includes and excludes, in English).

language.description: Label language (ISO 639-1 code of an EU language), or all for every language.

limit.description: Maximum search results for a words query.

query.description: Words to search for instead of a code, in any EU language (for example software or Programmierung).

scheme.description: Which classification the code or search belongs to. UK SIC 2007 codes have five digits and map to NACE Rev. 2.
